title: Tip & Bill Splitter
steps: HTML Structure → Add inputs for bill amount, tip percentage (<select>), people count, and a Calculate button
DOM Selection → Select elements using document.querySelector("#bill"), etc.
Core Logic → Write calc(): tip = bill * pct / 100, total = bill + tip, perPerson = total / people
Validation → Display a clear error message if bill <= 0 or people < 1
Formatting → Format numbers with toFixed(2) and render safely via textContent
UX Trigger → Invoke calc() on both button click and Enter keydown
Currency Bonus → Format output cleanly using Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", { style: "currency", currency: "INR" })
Verification → Test: bill 1000, tip 10%, 4 people => 275.00 per person

title: Todo App with localStorage
steps: HTML UI → Add task input, Add button, ul#list, and filter buttons (All / Active / Done)
State Setup → Initialize todos from localStorage.getItem("todos") as [{ id, text, done }]
Safe Render → Build render() to replace list items using createElement & textContent (never raw innerHTML)
Add Task → On submit, trim input, push { id: Date.now(), text, done: false }, save(), and render()
Event Delegation → Attach one click listener on ul#list using e.target.closest("li") to toggle/delete
Persistence → Call save() (localStorage.setItem with JSON.stringify) after every state update
Filtering → Filter visible tasks via currentFilter using todos.filter()
Bonus Polish → Add double-click inline editing, Clear Completed button, and active item count

title: Digital Clock + Stopwatch + Countdown
steps: Digital Clock → Update clock element every 1000ms with new Date().toLocaleTimeString()
Stopwatch State → Track running flag, startTime timestamp, and elapsed milliseconds
Start Action → Compute startTime = Date.now() - elapsed and start a 100ms interval
Pause & Reset → Pause with clearInterval while keeping elapsed; Reset clears interval & zeros state
Time Formatter → Build fmt(ms) returning mm:ss.t padded with String.padStart(2, "0")
Countdown Timer → Read target date/time input, compute remaining = target - Date.now(), notify at 0
Accuracy Tip → Always derive elapsed duration from Date.now() rather than counting interval ticks

title: Quiz App
steps: Quiz Dataset → Define questions = [{ q, options: [...], answer: index }, ...] with 10 questions
Quiz State → Track current = 0, score = 0, and answered = false
Render Question → Create showQuestion() to render the prompt and clickable option buttons
Answer Selection → Highlight right/wrong choices, increment score if correct, disable options
Next Flow → Increment current on Next; render final score summary after the last question
Results Screen → Show score, percentage, feedback message, and a Restart Quiz button
Bonus Polish → Add per-question countdown timer, Fisher-Yates shuffle, and localStorage high score

title: Calculator
steps: Layout Grid → Create display screen plus keypad buttons for digits, operators, "=", "C", and "."
State Machine → Track current input string, previous operand, and pending operator
Digit Input → Append digits to current string while blocking duplicate decimal points
Operator Handling → If previous and current exist, call compute() first, then store new operator
Safe Compute → Implement compute(a, b, op) with switch(op) and return "Error" on divide-by-zero
Equals & Clear → Compute final result on "=" and reset state cleanly on "C"
Keyboard Support → Bind keydown events so number, operator, Enter, and Escape keys work seamlessly
Security Rule → Never use eval() — always evaluate through your explicit compute() function

title: Random User / Weather App with fetch
steps: Choose Public API → Use a keyless API such as Random User (https://randomuser.me/api/) or Open-Meteo Weather
HTML Elements → Add fetch button/search input, result card container, loading spinner, and error banner
Async Fetch Flow → Show loader → try fetch(url) + check r.ok + await r.json() → catch error → finally hide loader
Render Card → Destructure fields from API JSON response and render cleanly into the card container
Network Inspection → Inspect status codes, headers, and JSON payloads in browser DevTools Network tab
Request Timeout → Wrap fetch with AbortController + 5s timeout to prevent hanging requests
Bonus Polish → Cache last successful response in localStorage and add a city selector dropdown

title: Expense Tracker
steps: Entry Form → Fields for description, amount, type (income/expense), category, and date
State & Storage → Store entries as [{ id, desc, amount, type, category, date }] synced with localStorage
Validation & CRUD → Add/delete entries with guard checks (amount > 0, non-empty description)
Summary Totals → Calculate total income, expense, and net balance using Array.reduce()
Category Breakdown → Group expenses by category with reduce and display bars/summary table
Filter & Sort → Filter by month or category and sort entries by date or amount
Currency Formatting → Format values with Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", { style: "currency", currency: "INR" })
Bonus Export → Export filtered ledger to downloadable CSV using Blob + anchor download attribute

title: Tic-Tac-Toe with Win Detection
steps: Game State → Initialize board = Array(9).fill(null) and current turn = "X"
Grid Board → Render a 3×3 CSS Grid of cells tagged with data-index="0..8"
Move Handler → On cell click, verify cell is empty and game active → set board[i] = turn → render
Winner Check → Scan WIN combinations with .find() to match three identical non-null marks
Draw & Restart → Detect draw via board.every(Boolean) with no winner, and wire a Restart button
Bonus AI → Add an optional bot player (first random valid move, then Minimax)

title: Image Slider / Carousel
steps: Track Layout → Place slides inside a flex track wrapped in an overflow: hidden viewport
Slide Transform → Maintain current index and shift track via transform = translateX(-index * 100%)
Wrap Navigation → Wire Prev/Next controls using modulo wrap-around: (i + n) % n
Indicator Dots → Render slide indicator dots synced with an active class
Autoplay Control → Advance with setInterval and pause cleanly on mouseenter / focusin
Keyboard & Touch → Support ArrowLeft / ArrowRight keys and mobile touchstart/touchend swipe
Accessibility → Add descriptive aria-label attributes on buttons and alt attributes on slides

title: Password Generator + Strength Meter
steps: Controls UI → Build length range slider plus checkboxes for uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols
Character Pools → Maintain string pools per option and combine active pools dynamically
Secure Random → Generate unbiased indices with crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(len))
Character Guarantee → Ensure at least one character from every selected pool appears in the password
Strength Meter → Evaluate length and character-class regex variety as Weak / Medium / Strong
Clipboard Copy → Copy output via navigator.clipboard.writeText and show temporary Copied! badge
Security Note → Always prefer crypto.getRandomValues() over Math.random() for security-sensitive generation

title: Movie/Book Search with Debounce
steps: Public Search API → Query a free endpoint like Open Library (openlibrary.org/search.json?q=...)
Debounced Input → Wrap the search handler with debounce(300ms) to avoid spamming API requests
Safe URL Builder → Build encoded query strings cleanly using new URLSearchParams({ q })
Race Prevention → Cancel stale in-flight requests using AbortController on each new keystroke
UI States → Render result cards along with dedicated empty, loading, and error states
Pagination → Support page parameters via Next/Prev buttons or Load More trigger
Favorites → Persist bookmarked search results in localStorage
Bonus Scroll → Upgrade Load More using IntersectionObserver for infinite scrolling

title: REST API with Node + Express
steps: Project Init → Run mkdir api && cd api && npm init -y && npm i express
ESM Config → Add "type": "module" in package.json
Express App → Create server.js with const app = express() and app.use(express.json())
Read Routes → Set up in-memory todos array with GET /todos and GET /todos/:id
Create + Validate → On POST /todos, validate req.body.text → return 201 Created or 400 Bad Request
Update & Delete → Implement PUT/PATCH /todos/:id and DELETE /todos/:id (404 when missing)
Middleware → Add request logger middleware (method, url, latency) and central error handler
Testing & Storage → Test routes with curl/Postman; bonus: persist todos JSON with fs.promises
